name: India Lease Development Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, India Lease Development Ltd is engaged in Hire Purchase & Leasing business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ILDL is promoted by The Motor and General Finance Limited, with equity participation from International Finance Corporation (an associate of The World Bank) and Punjab National Bank. Previously, the company focused on financing commercial vehicles, automobiles, construction, earthmoving equipment, and machinery, primarily serving small road transport operators (SRTOs) with one to five trucks and small-to-medium contractors in road construction, mining, and allied sectors. It is registered under Category 'B' as a Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Institution.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -2.94% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.07% over last 3 years.
